correctness.rationale: PASS: Contracting any prescribed M_sigma preserves its spanning-tree completions bijectively, counting parallel edges. Between distinct contracted vertices the multiplicity is 2-1_{sigma(i)=j}-1_{sigma(j)=i}; hence the exact Laplacian is L=2(n-1)I-2J+P_sigma+P_sigma^T. Fourier modes on derangement cycles give the null eigenvalue, 2n with multiplicity c-1, and internal eigenvalues 2(n-1)+2cos(2pi h/ell). The matrix-tree theorem and the Chebyshev identity product_h(x+2cos(2pi h/ell))=2(T_ell(x/2)-(-1)^ell) yield the formula, treating 2-cycles with multiplicity two in P+P^T. Independently recomputed the exact quotient multigraph cofactor versus the integer Chebyshev formula for every derangement on n=3..6 (2,9,44,265 cases). The crown Laplacian separately confirms tau(Cr_n)=(n-1)n^(n-2)(n-2)^(n-1). Bounded tests support the unbounded eigenvalue proof.

value.rationale: PASS: Counting spanning-tree completions of a specified perfect matching is a natural exact network-reliability/random-spanning-tree observable. The automorphism-breaking interaction of two distinct perfect matchings in a crown graph makes derangement cycle type mathematically relevant, yielding a genuinely reusable all-order product rather than a routine known tree-total substitution.

final_claim: For n>=3 and each perfect matching M_sigma in the crown graph Cr_n=K_{n,n} minus the diagonal matching, with sigma a derangement of cycle lengths ell_1,...,ell_c, the number of spanning trees containing M_sigma is (2^(c-1)/n^2)*product_j(T_ell_j(n-1)-(-1)^ell_j); it depends on cycle type, including 32 versus 36 for n=4.
limitations: Only prescribed perfect matchings, not arbitrary forced forests in crown graphs.
